description: Wondershare EdrawMax is open and showing its Home screen. The left sidebar shows tool icons (Symbols, Text, Images, etc.) and the canvas center shows a 'Create New' card with a + icon. Click the 'Create New' card in the center of the canvas, then select 'Flowchart' from the diagram type categories that appear. If a blue notification banner ('Click here to view more temporarily saved files') is visible at the top, click its 'Got it' button to dismiss it before proceeding. Create a flowchart depicting the Git pull request workflow (a real software development process) with the following shapes connected by directional arrows: (1) oval labeled 'Start', (2) rectangle labeled 'Create Feature Branch', (3) rectangle labeled 'Write Code & Commit', (4) rectangle labeled 'Push Branch to Remote', (5) rectangle labeled 'Open Pull Request', (6) diamond labeled 'Tests Pass?', (7) rectangle labeled 'Fix Failures' (on No branch, looping back to Write Code), (8) rectangle labeled 'Code Review' (on Yes branch), (9) diamond labeled 'Approved?', (10) rectangle labeled 'Request Changes' (on No branch, looping back to Write Code), (11) rectangle labeled 'Merge to Main' (on Yes branch), (12) oval labeled 'End'. Save the diagram as 'git_pr_flowchart.eddx' in /home/ga/ using File > Save As.
